content.text: Which 2D coordinates represent where the mug should be placed to make a cup of coffee? The coordinates are represented in (y x) format where each number is between 0 and 1000. (0 0) represents the top left of the image while (1000 1000) represents the bottom right. Choices:  A. (274 638). B. (470 625). C. (425 63). D. (571 492). Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
